jei.autarkia.info.arc_rifle: 5,000 FE per shot, 32 blocks. 10 arc damage, then 3 hops within 6 blocks at x0.7 (7, 4.9, 3.4). Skips you, your pets, villagers and workers. 1 s cooldown. 1,000,000 FE.
jei.autarkia.info.basic_circuit: Crafting table or fabricator. For electric machines and drones.
jei.autarkia.info.battery_bank: Stores 400,000 FE, I/O 1,024 FE/t, no leak. Charges an FE item in its slot at 2,048 FE/t.
jei.autarkia.info.belt: Conveyor, 2 blocks/s, 2 entries of up to 8 items per block. All belts of a line share the head's 1,000 FE buffer and use 1 FE/t each. Inputs at the back, the sides and the top; output into the block in front. A blocked line jams after 30 s.
jei.autarkia.info.belt_splitter: Inline: Alternate sends entries front and side in turn (the other output when one is full); Filter sends matching entries to the side. 2 FE/t.
jei.autarkia.info.blast_smelter: 2 x 2 x 2 heavy machine on foundation. 64 FE/t heats it to 1,000 (+10 per tick); it works only when hot. 3 washed ore to 4 ingots, 1 iron + 2 coal to steel, 3 copper + 1 zinc to 4 brass, and any furnace recipe in 100 ticks.
jei.autarkia.info.boiler: 2 x 3 x 2. Burns fuel at fire level 0 to 4 (GUI) and makes 10 mB steam per level per tick from water (bucket slot, pipes or water sources next to its bottom). Pressure = steam / 400 bar. It bursts at 12 bar or after 10 s dry at 200 C.
jei.autarkia.info.brass_ingot: Crucible or blast smelter: 3 copper + 1 zinc.
jei.autarkia.info.bronze_axe: Strips logs, disables shields for 5 s. 9 damage.
jei.autarkia.info.bronze_pickaxe: Mines what an iron pickaxe mines. Speed 6.5, 300 uses.
jei.autarkia.info.bronze_sling: Hold use 5 to 20 ticks, then release. Throws cobblestone (3 damage) or any nugget (4 damage). 1 durability per shot, 0.5 s cooldown.
jei.autarkia.info.bronze_sword: 6 damage, 1.6 attacks per second, sweep attack.
jei.autarkia.info.builder_drone: T3 drone, FE battery 80,000. Flies; places, cuts and repairs blocks (any block), strings spans up to insulated. Charges at a recharge dock.
jei.autarkia.info.capacitor_bank: Energy storage: 50,000 FE, I/O 2,048 FE/t, small leak. Charges an FE item in its slot. Takes lightning energy without a rate limit.
jei.autarkia.info.capsule_station: Sends and receives one stack per capsule. Mode Send, Receive or Both; filter; priority 0 to 9. A launch costs 40 FE, one per 10 ticks. Capsules go to matching filtered stations first (highest priority, then nearest), else to stations with an empty filter. A capsule that cannot unload waits 30 s, then re-targets or returns home.
jei.autarkia.info.capsule_tube: Glass tube for capsules, 8 blocks/s. Connects to tubes and to station mouths on all sides. A network holds up to 512 tubes and 32 stations; over the cap it stops. Breaking a tube drops the capsules inside it.
jei.autarkia.info.catwalk: See-through steel grate to walk on.
jei.autarkia.info.chute: Gravity slide: 1 to 4 items per entry slide down and leave one block lower in front. Right-click inserts; it also pulls from an inventory above. A full target makes items wait; nothing drops.
jei.autarkia.info.copper_wire_spool: Copper wire: click one node, then another (max 16 blocks, rated 256 FE/t). Above its rating the wire heats: orange at 40%, red at 70%, it snaps with arcs at 100% and can set fires.
jei.autarkia.info.core_seed: Use on the top of dirt or stone with a free 3 x 3 x 3 space. The Core grows for 10 s, then claims a 33 x 33 domain, gives a Porter capsule and a field manual.
jei.autarkia.info.core_upgrade_t2: Use on an active T1 Colony Core (owner or trusted): the Core upgrades for 5 s, then the colony is T2 with a bigger domain, more workers and the T2 templates.
jei.autarkia.info.core_upgrade_t3: Use on a T2 Colony Core: T3, domain half-size 32, 14 workers, Builder Drones, warehouse, failure memory.
jei.autarkia.info.crab_frame: The frame of a Hauler Crab or Loader.
jei.autarkia.info.crate: 27-slot storage. The top shows piles of its contents. Sneak + use with a wrench picks it up with everything inside.
jei.autarkia.info.crucible: Alloys over heat: 3 copper + 1 tin = 4 bronze. Lit campfire 0.5x, lit furnace 1.0x, lava 1.5x speed.
jei.autarkia.info.deepslate_zinc_ore: Zinc ore in deepslate. Drops raw zinc.
jei.autarkia.info.domain_beacon: Place inside a T3+ domain: adds a square of half-size 16 (T5+: 24) around it. Needs 32 FE/t; without power its area is INACTIVE and the planner ignores it. Max 2 at T3, 3 at T4, 4 at T5, 6 at T6.
jei.autarkia.info.drone_frame: Frame of the Builder Drone, Surveyor, Cable-Layer and Sentinel.
jei.autarkia.info.electric_chainsaw: Axe, speed 12, 9 damage. Cutting a log fells the whole tree (up to 256 logs, 16 per tick, 150 FE per log). Sneak to cut one log.
jei.autarkia.info.electric_drill: Pickaxe and shovel, diamond level, speed 12. 400,000 FE, 200 FE per block. Empty: speed 1, no drops.
jei.autarkia.info.electrolyzer: 256 FE/t, 160 ticks: 1 pure ore to 1 ingot plus a secondary nugget at 10%.
jei.autarkia.info.exo_rig_boots: 3 armor, 2 toughness. Cancels fall damage above 3 blocks for 100 FE per block. 500,000 FE.
jei.autarkia.info.exo_rig_chest: 7 armor, 2 toughness. +0.25 jump strength, 100 FE per jump. 500,000 FE.
jei.autarkia.info.exo_rig_helmet: 3 armor, 2 toughness. Balances FE between the worn exo pieces every second, +1 oxygen. 500,000 FE. Suit key: on/off.
jei.autarkia.info.exo_rig_legs: 6 armor, 2 toughness. Step up 1.1 blocks, 2 FE per tick while walking. 500,000 FE.
jei.autarkia.info.fabricator: 2 x 2 x 1. 160 FE/t. Pick a target recipe with the recipe button; it pulls the ingredients from its 3 x 3 buffer and makes circuits, servos, frames and equipment.
jei.autarkia.info.field_manual: The Autarkia guide: tiers, machines, the colony and its workers.
jei.autarkia.info.foundation: Heavy building block. Heavy machines from T2 need it under every bottom position.
jei.autarkia.info.fuse_box: Inline node with exactly 2 spans of one tier. Opens at 100% load for 1 s or 150% at once, or when lightning reaches it; closes again after 10 s. After 3 trips in a minute it stays open until reset (button or wrench).
jei.autarkia.info.hand_crank: Generator. Hold use on it to turn: 20 FE/t (a Porter gives 10 FE/t). Buffer 1,000 FE, out 40 FE/t. Output stops 6 ticks after you let go.
jei.autarkia.info.industrial_lamp: Light 15 while it has power (1 FE/t). Flickers when its network cannot keep it full. When a snap cuts its supply it goes dark 3 ticks per hop from the break.
jei.autarkia.info.insulated_cable_spool: Insulated cable: 1,024 FE/t, spans up to 24 blocks (12 to or from a wall insulator), loss 0.1% per block. One spool per 16 blocks. Overload heats it: smoke, flame, snap, fire.
jei.autarkia.info.jaw_crusher: 2 x 2 x 2 heavy machine on foundation. 192 FE/t, 100 ticks: 1 raw ore to 2 crushed ore; cobblestone to gravel, gravel to sand.
jei.autarkia.info.ledger_terminal: Search the warehouse stock and request 1 to 1,728 of an item. A Loader brings the crate: the items go to you within 6 blocks, else to the 18-slot output. Items in the 9 input slots are put away; empty crates in the crate slot become new stock positions.
jei.autarkia.info.lightning_arrester: Place on top of a pole: a lightning pulse stops there. Next to a machine: it protects that machine.
jei.autarkia.info.lightning_mast: 4 blocks tall. Bolts within 48 blocks move to it; it puts 120,000 FE into the capacitor banks of its network. Thunder can strike it on its own.
jei.autarkia.info.lineman: T3 walker, FE battery 60,000. Climbs poles at 0.1 blocks/tick; strings and cuts spans up to insulated, places fuse boxes and poles.
jei.autarkia.info.loader: T3 forklift crab, FE battery 120,000. Carries warehouse crates between racks and ledger terminals (1,500 FE per lift).
jei.autarkia.info.magnetic_separator: 128 FE/t, 120 ticks: 2 washed ore to 3 pure ore, 1 slag and a secondary nugget at 50%.
jei.autarkia.info.multimeter: Use on a connector or machine port: shows the network generation, demand, service, losses and every span of that node.
jei.autarkia.info.pattern_card: Blank, or a recorded Pattern. Insert a recorded card in the Core's Patterns tab to add it to the library.
jei.autarkia.info.pattern_loom: Records a box of up to the tier size into a Pattern on a blank card: Autarkia machine settings are kept, foreign block entities are placed empty. Protect watches the box; Library adds the Pattern to the colony.
jei.autarkia.info.planning_tablet: Use on a Colony Core to link. While held, the colony's proposals show as ghost blocks. Use to open the project list and the autonomy switch.
jei.autarkia.info.plate_press: 48 FE/t, 80 ticks: 1 ingot to 1 plate (steel, brass).
jei.autarkia.info.pressure_valve: Place on top of a boiler: vents 25 mB/t of steam above 9 bar. One valve cannot hold fire level 4 with no load; two can.
jei.autarkia.info.project_board: Place inside a domain: shows the colony's proposals with their reason, site, cost and bill of materials. Approve, deny or show the ghost.
jei.autarkia.info.prop_beam: Temporary support. Workers put it under racks of a failing row before they replace them.
jei.autarkia.info.pure_copper: Magnetic separator: 2 washed to 3 pure. Smelts or electrolyzes to 1 ingot.
jei.autarkia.info.pure_gold: Magnetic separator: 2 washed to 3 pure. Smelts or electrolyzes to 1 ingot.
jei.autarkia.info.pure_iron: Magnetic separator: 2 washed to 3 pure. Smelts or electrolyzes to 1 ingot.
jei.autarkia.info.pure_tin: Magnetic separator: 2 washed to 3 pure. Smelts or electrolyzes to 1 ingot.
jei.autarkia.info.pure_zinc: Magnetic separator: 2 washed to 3 pure. Smelts or electrolyzes to 1 ingot.
jei.autarkia.info.quern: Manual grinder. Use with ore to insert, hold use with an empty hand to turn. 8 turns per raw ore: 1 crushed ore plus 1 more at 50%. Outputs go to an inventory below.
jei.autarkia.info.recharge_dock: 50,000 FE buffer from any cable. Charges one FE worker at up to 2,000 FE/t and heals 1 health per 5 s for 500 FE. Drones land on top.
jei.autarkia.info.rope_coil: Rope drive cable: click one node, then another (max 12 blocks, rated 40 FE/t, 1 coil per 8 blocks). Above 40 FE/t the rope slips, wears and snaps.
jei.autarkia.info.rope_pulley: Rope drive connector node. Takes up to 4 rope spans of max 12 blocks. Machines and generators next to it join its network.
jei.autarkia.info.servo: Fabricator. For workers and T4 machines.
jei.autarkia.info.shock_baton: 6 damage. With 1,000 FE a hit adds 4 shock damage and Slowness II for 2 s. 200,000 FE.
jei.autarkia.info.slag: Byproduct of the blast smelter. 4 slag make 2 foundation.
jei.autarkia.info.sluice: 1 x 1 x 3. Washes crushed ore: 1 crushed to 1 washed plus a secondary nugget at 10%, 100 ticks. The block behind or above the head needs water: flowing water 100%, a source only 50%. Outputs go into an inventory or belt in front of the tail, else drop.
jei.autarkia.info.sorting_chute: Inline, no power: entries that match the filter leave through the side, the rest go on. A full side blocks it.
jei.autarkia.info.stamp_mill: Powered grinder (2 blocks tall). 16 FE/t, 8 s per raw ore: 1 crushed ore plus 1 more at 50%.
jei.autarkia.info.steam_engine: 1 x 2 x 2. Its back face must touch a boiler. Uses up to 20 mB steam per tick: 6 FE per mB, max 120 FE/t. A boiler feeds at most 2 engines.
jei.autarkia.info.steam_repeater: Sneak + hold use pumps pressure (40 ticks to 100). Hold use fires a steel nugget every 5 ticks for 10 pressure: 5 damage. Pressure leaks 1 per second when not in use.
jei.autarkia.info.steam_turbine: 3 x 3 x 2. Takes up to 100 mB of steam per tick from 1 to 4 boilers touching its back or sides. The rotor spins up in 30 s and down in 60 s; out = rotor x steam x 10 FE/t, max 1,000.
jei.autarkia.info.steel_axe: Strips logs, disables shields for 5 s. 9 damage.
jei.autarkia.info.steel_pickaxe: Mines what a diamond pickaxe mines. Speed 7.5, 1,200 uses.
jei.autarkia.info.steel_pylon: 1 x 5 x 1 node for insulated cable, 6 spans. Feeds the machines next to it.
jei.autarkia.info.steel_rack: Holds 3 crates (filled or empty). Load rating 8,192 units. Bends above 100%, collapses after 60 s above 120%, at once above 150%. Drops 2 steel nuggets when it collapses.
jei.autarkia.info.steel_sledgehammer: Mode key: 1x1 or 3x3. 3x3 breaks the plane at right angles to the hit face at 35% speed, 1 durability per block. 10.5 damage, disables shields.
jei.autarkia.info.steel_sword: 6.5 damage, 1.6 attacks per second, sweep attack.
jei.autarkia.info.stone_flywheel: Energy storage with inertia: 40,000 FE, in/out 40 x spin. Needs a solid block under its middle. Break it while it holds 2,000 FE or more and the wheel rolls away and hits what is in its path.
jei.autarkia.info.survey_lens: Hold it: outlines of the ore deposits within 64 blocks, through the ground, in the color of the ore.
jei.autarkia.info.tally_board: Counts the items of all crates within 5 blocks every 2 seconds and shows the 6 largest counts on its face. The Colony Core reads it.
jei.autarkia.info.transformer: Joins two cable tiers: side A is the tier of the first span, side B the next. Moves up to the lower tier's rating per tick with 2% loss. Wrench: Auto (from the network with more spare power), A to B, B to A.
jei.autarkia.info.treadwheel: Generator. Use a lead on it while leading a horse, donkey, mule or llama (20 FE/t), a villager (16) or a cow, pig, sheep or goat (12). Sneak + use with an empty hand takes the walker back. A Porter gives 24 FE/t.
jei.autarkia.info.walker_frame: The frame of a Porter or Lineman.
jei.autarkia.info.wall_insulator: Small node on a wall face for insulated cable, 2 spans of at most 12 blocks.
jei.autarkia.info.warehouse_controller: Indexes the racks within 16 blocks (cube; config 8 to 32), up to 256. Queues up to 16 ledger requests and hands each trip to a Loader. 64 FE/t while requests are open.
jei.autarkia.info.waterwheel: Generator, 3 wide and 3 tall. Flowing water under the bottom row (24 FE/t per block) or falling water on the top (40 FE/t per block) turns it; max 128 FE/t. Sources do not count.
jei.autarkia.info.winding_post: Charger for spring workers: 40 T/t for 80 FE/t from a cable, or 10 T/t while a player holds use on it.
jei.autarkia.info.windmill: Generator, 4 blocks tall. Output 4 to 40 FE/t: higher rotors, stronger wind and rain or thunder give more. Every solid block in the 5 x 5 area in front of the rotor costs 10%; 5 or more stop it.
jei.autarkia.info.wire_cutter: Click one node, then the other: the span is removed and its cable comes back.
jei.autarkia.info.wire_drawer: 40 FE/t, 100 ticks: 4 copper + iron core to 2 copper coils; 2 copper with no core to 1 copper wire spool.
jei.autarkia.info.wood_rack: Holds 2 crates (filled or empty). Load rating 2,048 units: light items 0.25, most items 0.5, ingots and ores 1, machines 8, storage blocks 9, each crate 8. Above 100% it bends, above 120% it collapses after 60 s, above 150% (with a falling crate's impact) at once.
jei.autarkia.info.wooden_pole: Copper wire connector, 3 blocks tall. Takes up to 4 copper spans of max 16 blocks at its top. Machines next to its base join its network.
jei.autarkia.info.worker_assembler: 2 x 2 x 2. Put a frame and the parts in, give it FE: a Porter needs a walker frame, 2 mainsprings, 4 bronze gears and 4 bronze ingots, 600 ticks at 20 FE/t.
jei.autarkia.info.worker_capsule: Sneak + use on your idle worker to store it with its spring, cargo and upgrades. Use on the ground inside your domain to release it.
jei.autarkia.info.worker_upgrade_armor: Right-click a worker: +6 armor, +25% max health.
jei.autarkia.info.worker_upgrade_cargo: Right-click a worker: +1 carry slot (Loader: +9 pallet slots, 2 crates per trip), +5% move drain.
jei.autarkia.info.worker_upgrade_range: Right-click a worker: +2 reach, +50% charger search radius.
jei.autarkia.info.worker_upgrade_speed: Right-click a worker: +20% speed, +10% move drain. 2 slots per worker.
jei.autarkia.info.wrench: Use: turns Autarkia blocks. Sneak + use: picks up a crate with its contents, or any other Autarkia block.
jei.autarkia.info.zinc_ore: Zinc ore, Y 0 to 64. Drops raw zinc.
